app.name: NAI Recipe Studio
app.tagline: Build prompts, then keep the results close.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.description: Assemble prompts from editable blocks and save every version.
recipes.emptyDescription: Create a recipe or import a JSON file to start building your first prompt.
recipes.deleteDescription: This removes the saved recipe and its versions.
recipes.importHint: Choose a recipe JSON file. User-authored tags and text are kept as written.

editor.title: Recipe editor
editor.name: Recipe name
editor.emptyBlocks: Add a block from the palette on the left.
editor.leaveDescription: Your latest edits have not been saved.
editor.historyEmpty: No images generated from this recipe yet.
editor.savePresetTitle: Save this block as a palette preset

blocks.noCharacters: Add a character in Characters first.

generation.title: Generate
generation.description: Prepare a cost estimate, approve it, and run a controlled job.
generation.freeEstimate: The current account reports 0 Anlas for this plan. Usage limits still apply.
generation.costUnavailableHint: Generation stays paused until the account returns a verified estimate.
generation.noRecipe: Select a recipe to prepare a generation.
generation.noConnection: Connect NovelAI in Settings before generating.
generation.approvalHint: This plan expires at {{date}}. Changing the recipe or count requires a new estimate.
generation.pendingDescription: Plans prepared through MCP stay fixed until you approve them here.
generation.waitingForMcp: Approved. The connected MCP client can start this plan.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.description: Review generated images with their recipe and settings.
gallery.emptyDescription: Generated images will appear here with their recipe and generation settings.
gallery.notePlaceholder: What do you want to remember about this result?

palette.title: Block palette
palette.description: Save prompt fragments and reuse them in recipes.
palette.emptyDescription: Create a block from a recipe or add a neutral starter block.
palette.name: Block name
palette.preserve: Tags remain unchanged when you switch languages.

characters.title: Characters
characters.description: Register characters once, then place them in any recipe.
characters.emptyDescription: Add a character to use the cast block.
characters.deleteDescription: Existing recipes keep their saved member data.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Connect services and choose how the app behaves.
settings.languageDescription: Choose the app language. Your recipes, tags, and prompt text do not change.
settings.connectionDescription: Image generation uses your NovelAI account. Editing and checking recipes works offline.
settings.tokenHelp: In NovelAI, open User Settings → Account → Get Persistent API Token, then paste the token here.
settings.clearTokenConfirm: Remove the saved NovelAI token from this device?
settings.connectionFailure: Could not connect to NovelAI. Check the token and network.
settings.storageDescription: Recipes and images are kept in the app data folder.
settings.blurDescription: Hide rated images until you reveal them.

ai.title: AI connection
ai.description: Connect an AI tool to edit recipes and prepare generation work through MCP.
ai.clientUnavailable: This AI client was not detected or does not support setup.

settings.setupHint: The setup changes only the selected client profile and preserves other entries.
settings.permissionHint: The connected AI tool can read and edit the workspace you choose.
settings.aboutDescription: An independent desktop tool for NovelAI prompt recipes. You need your own NovelAI account and API token to generate images.

settingsExtra.connectionsDescription: Choose the MCP profile and per-plan limits used by connected tools.
settingsExtra.noConnections: Create a connection profile before installing MCP setup.
settingsExtra.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{name}}? Connected clients will stop working.
settingsExtra.notInstalled: No setup is installed for this client.
settingsExtra.connectionRequired: Create or select a connection profile first.
settingsExtra.uninstallConfirm: Remove this client's managed MCP setup?

errors.conflict: This recipe changed elsewhere. Reload it before saving.
errors.invalidRecipe: This file is not a supported recipe JSON.
errors.generation: The generation request failed. It was not retried automatically.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: This recipe changed elsewhere. Reload it before saving.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The requested item was not found.
errors.RESULT_UNKNOWN: The result could not be confirmed. It may still have used account credits, so it was not retried.
errors.STORAGE_FULL: There is not enough storage space. Choose another folder or free space.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: The app could not complete that action.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: This connected tool does not have permission for that action.
errors.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Approve the generation plan in the app before starting.
errors.COST_UNKNOWN: The current cost could not be confirmed.
errors.COST_CHANGED: The estimate changed. Prepare a new plan before starting.
errors.APP_CLOSED: The app is closing. The request was stopped.
errors.PLAN_EXPIRED: The generation plan expired. Prepare a new plan.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This generation request was already started with different data.
errors.NOT_SUPPORTED: This action is not supported yet.
errors.CREDENTIAL_PROTECTION_UNAVAILABLE: Secure token storage is not available on this device.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Requests are temporarily limited. Wait, then prepare a new plan.
errors.GENERATION_REJECTED: NovelAI rejected the generation request. Check your account and generation settings.
errors.SETUP_CONFLICT: The AI configuration was changed elsewhere. It was preserved; review it before installing.
errors.PATH_NOT_ALLOWED: This file path cannot be accessed.
errors.EXTERNAL_URL_BLOCKED: The app cannot open this external address.
errors.CLIENT_UNSUPPORTED: This AI client setup is not supported on this device.
errors.REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: The request is too large. Reduce its size.
errors.POLICY_BLOCKED: The selected characters and content settings cannot be used together.
